project.name: erpnext-domain-logic
project.system_context: Computational domain engine representing the accounting, manufacturing, inventory, hr, lending, support, crm, trade, and learning systems. Target Stack: rust_decimal = "=1.42.0" (with maths enabled), SurrealDB 3.0.5, Chrono 0.4.
project.directory_structure: erpnext-domain/ ├── Cargo.toml └── crates/ ├── erp-accounting/ # Double-entry postings, balance sheet generation │ └── src/ │ ├── lib.rs │ ├── posting.rs │ └── balance_sheet.rs ├── erp-inventory/ # FIFO/Moving average stock ledger, valuation corrections, stock transfers │ └── src/ │ ├── lib.rs │ ├── stock_ledger.rs │ ├── transfers.rs │ └── fifo_valuation.rs ├── erp-manufacturing/ # Recursive BOM cost rollups, MRP demand/supply pipelines │ └── src/ │ ├── lib.rs │ ├── bom.rs │ └── mrp.rs ├── erp-hr/ # Payroll, progressive tax engine, attendance │ └── src/ │ ├── lib.rs │ ├── payroll.rs │ └── attendance.rs ├── erp-crm/ # Lead scoring and sales pipeline stage tracking │ └── src/ │ ├── lib.rs │ ├── lead_scoring.rs │ └── pipeline.rs ├── erp-support/ # Service Level Agreement (SLA) status tracking │ └── src/ │ ├── lib.rs │ └── sla.rs ├── erp-lending/ # Loan amortization calculations (EMI, Reducing Balance) │ └── src/ │ ├── lib.rs │ └── amortization.rs ├── erp-trade/ # Customer pricing rules and taxation templates │ └── src/ │ ├── lib.rs │ ├── pricing_rules.rs │ └── tax_templates.rs └── erp-learning/ # Training and learning progress tracking └── src/ ├── lib.rs └── learning_progress.rs

key_invariants.invariant: All arithmetic for balances, tax rates, routing costs, and values must use high-precision rust_decimal::Decimal to prevent float drift.
SurrealDB v3 uses surrealdb::types::RecordId. The RecordId struct does not implement Display; use .to_sql() to insert it into SQL statements.
Recursive BOM costing must expand Phantom BOM nodes inline. Routing costs must be summed recursively alongside components.
Salary components are evaluated dynamically using the Rhai scripting engine. Formulas must be valid Rhai expressions.
Valuation updates downstream of backdated stock entries must re-sort downstream items chronologically and recalculate COGS / stock queue.
